In this notebook, we attempt to predict species sensitivity based on
phylogeny. For each chemical group and mask fraction, we fit a
multivariate phylogenetic model using `Rphylopars` package. The input
trait matrix is the ML-predicted species × CAS table with masked cells
set to NA.

Using the complete species sensitivity dataset generated by the machine
learning model, we randomly mask 50% of species per chemical to be
treated as missing and predict their sensitivity based on the phylogeny
and the remaining 50% of species with known sensitivity. We repeated
this prediction process for 30% and 70%.

Performance metrics:

We report performance metrics both on the full sample and the
masked-only subset to show the comparison between Phylo-predicted and
ML-predicted (phylo_sensi vs ML_sensi), between ML-predicted and
Observed (ML_sensi vs observed), between Phylo-predicted and Observed
(phylo_sensi vs observed).

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
rm(list=ls())   
library(here)
library(tidyverse)  
library(ape)
library(Rphylopars)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

set.seed(1010)
```

# 1. Load dataset

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
spe_tax_phylo_BM_FFG_sensi_subCAS <- readRDS(here("data/6_combined/spe_tax_phylo_BM_FFG_sensi_subCAS.rds"))

phylo_tree <- readRDS(here("data/6_combined/phylo_tree.rds"))

observed_sensi <- readRDS(here("data/1_observed_sensitivity/combined_observed_sensitivity/combined_observed_sensitivity.rds"))
```

```{r}
chem_groups <- c("Arthropod_control", "Auxiliary_other",
                 "Fungal_control", "Vertebrate_control",
                 "Plant_control", "Mixed_multitarget")

mask_fracs <- c(0.30, 0.50, 0.70) 

fits_dir <- here("model_output/phylopars_fits")
dir.create(fits_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

# 2. Fit phylopars
Functions:
```{r}
# Build species x CAS wide and mask a fraction per CAS
build_and_mask_wide <- function(dat, chemgroup, mask_frac) {
  wide <- dat %>%
    filter(duration == "24") %>%
    filter(chem_group == chemgroup) %>%
    group_by(latin, CAS) %>%
    summarise(val = mean(log_sensi, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = CAS, values_from = val) %>%
    rename(species = latin) %>%
    distinct()
  
  if (nrow(wide) == 0) return(NULL)
  rownames(wide) <- wide$species
  
  trait_mv  <- wide
  cas_cols  <- setdiff(names(trait_mv), "species")
  
  masked_pairs <- purrr::map_dfr(cas_cols, function(cn) {
    sp_nonmiss <- trait_mv$species[!is.na(trait_mv[[cn]])]
    n_mask <- max(1, floor(mask_frac * length(sp_nonmiss)))
    tibble(species = sample(sp_nonmiss, n_mask), CAS = cn)})
  
  if (nrow(masked_pairs) > 0) {
    idx <- match(masked_pairs$species, trait_mv$species)
    for (j in seq_len(nrow(masked_pairs))) {
      trait_mv[idx[j], masked_pairs$CAS[j]] <- NA
    }
  }
  
  list(wide_full = wide, trait_mv = trait_mv, masked_pairs = masked_pairs)
}

# Fit phylopars
fit_phylopars <- function(trait_mv, tree) {
  phylopars(
    trait_data       = trait_mv,
    tree             = tree,
    model            = "lambda",
    pheno_error      = FALSE,
    phylo_correlated = FALSE,
    pheno_correlated = FALSE
    )
}

fit_and_save_all <- function(mask_frac) {
  all_results <- list()
  
  for (g in chem_groups) {
    message("Fitting: ", g, " | mask ", mask_frac)
    wm <- build_and_mask_wide(spe_tax_phylo_BM_FFG_sensi_subCAS, g, mask_frac)
    
    fit <- fit_phylopars(wm$trait_mv, phylo_tree)
    res <- list(
      chem_group   = g,
      mask_frac    = mask_frac,
      fit          = fit,
      wide_full    = wm$wide_full,
      trait_mv     = wm$trait_mv,
      masked_pairs = wm$masked_pairs,
      lambda       = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(fit$model$lambda)))
    
    all_results[[g]] <- res
    saveRDS(res, file = file.path(fits_dir, paste0("phylopars_fit_", g, "_mask",
                              round(mask_frac * 100), ".rds")))
    }
  
  saveRDS(all_results, file = file.path(fits_dir, paste0("phylopars_fits_all_mask",
                              round(mask_frac * 100), ".rds")))
  invisible(all_results)
}

```

```{r eval=FALSE}
# run Rphylopars for each mask fraction
all_results_list <- lapply(mask_fracs, fit_and_save_all)
names(all_results_list) <- paste0("mask", round(mask_fracs * 100))
```

# 3. Summary of each chemical group
```{r}
rng <- function(x) range(x, na.rm = TRUE)

pearson <- function(x, y) {
  ok <- is.finite(x) & is.finite(y)
  ct <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(x[ok], y[ok], method = "pearson"))
  c(r = unname(ct$estimate), p_r = unname(ct$p.value))
}

spearman <- function(x, y) {
  ok <- is.finite(x) & is.finite(y)
  ct <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(x[ok], y[ok], method = "spearman", exact = FALSE))
  c(rho = unname(ct$estimate), p_rho = unname(ct$p.value))
}

err_stats <- function(x, y) {
  ok <- is.finite(x) & is.finite(y)
  if (!any(ok)) return(c(rmse = NA_real_))
  e <- y[ok] - x[ok]
  c(rmse = sqrt(mean(e^2)))
}

make_eval_df <- function(fit, wide_full, masked_pairs, observed_sensi) {
  tip_pred <- as.data.frame(fit$anc_recon[fit$tree$tip.label, , drop = FALSE]) %>%
    rownames_to_column("species") %>%
    pivot_longer(-species, names_to = "CAS", values_to = "phylo_sensi")

  ML_long <- wide_full %>%
   pivot_longer(-species, names_to = "CAS", values_to = "ML_sensi")

  obs_long <- observed_sensi %>%
    transmute(
      species  = as.character(latin),
      CAS      = as.character(CAS_norm),
      observed = as.numeric(conc)
    ) %>%
    distinct()

  tip_pred %>%
   left_join(ML_long, by = c("species","CAS")) %>%
    left_join(
      masked_pairs %>%
        transmute(species = as.character(species), CAS = as.character(CAS)) %>%
        mutate(masked = TRUE),
      by = c("species","CAS")
    ) %>%
    left_join(obs_long, by = c("species","CAS"))
}

pair_metrics <- function(prefix, x, y, tol = 0.3) {
  c(
    setNames(pearson(x, y),   paste0(prefix, c("_r","_p_r"))),
    setNames(spearman(x, y),  paste0(prefix, c("_rho","_p_rho"))),
    setNames(err_stats(x, y), paste0(prefix, c("_rmse")))
  )
}

one_fit_metrics <- function(chem_group, mask_frac, fit, wide_full, masked_pairs, observed_sensi, tol = 0.3) {
  df <- make_eval_df(fit, wide_full, masked_pairs, observed_sensi)

  # Ranges (full sample)
  r_phylo <- rng(df$phylo_sensi)
  r_ML    <- rng(df$ML_sensi)
  r_obs   <- rng(df$observed)

  # Full-sample metrics
  blk_pM <- pair_metrics("phylo_ML", df$ML_sensi, df$phylo_sensi, tol)
  blk_Mo <- pair_metrics("ML_obs",  df$observed, df$ML_sensi,    tol)
  blk_po <- pair_metrics("phylo_obs", df$observed, df$phylo_sensi, tol)

  n_phylo_ML  <- sum(is.finite(df$phylo_sensi) & is.finite(df$ML_sensi))
  n_ML_obs    <- sum(is.finite(df$ML_sensi)    & is.finite(df$observed))
  n_phylo_obs <- sum(is.finite(df$phylo_sensi) & is.finite(df$observed))

  # Masked-only
  m_keys <- masked_pairs %>%
    transmute(species = as.character(species), CAS = as.character(CAS))
  m_df <- df %>% semi_join(m_keys, by = c("species","CAS"))

  blk_pM_m <- pair_metrics("phylo_ML_masked", m_df$ML_sensi, m_df$phylo_sensi, tol)
  blk_Mo_m <- pair_metrics("ML_obs_masked", m_df$observed, m_df$ML_sensi,    tol)
  blk_po_m <- pair_metrics("phylo_obs_masked", m_df$observed, m_df$phylo_sensi, tol)

  n_phylo_ML_masked  <- sum(is.finite(m_df$phylo_sensi) & is.finite(m_df$ML_sensi))
  n_ML_obs_masked    <- sum(is.finite(m_df$ML_sensi)    & is.finite(m_df$observed))
  n_phylo_obs_masked <- sum(is.finite(m_df$phylo_sensi) & is.finite(m_df$observed))

  tibble::tibble(
    chem_group = chem_group,
    mask_frac  = mask_frac,
    phylo_sensi_min = r_phylo[1], phylo_sensi_max = r_phylo[2],
    ML_min          = r_ML[1],    ML_max          = r_ML[2],
    obs_min         = r_obs[1],   obs_max         = r_obs[2],
    # Ns (full sample)
    n_phylo_ML  = n_phylo_ML,
    n_ML_obs    = n_ML_obs,
    n_phylo_obs = n_phylo_obs,
    # Ns (masked only)
    n_phylo_ML_masked  = n_phylo_ML_masked,
    n_ML_obs_masked    = n_ML_obs_masked,
    n_phylo_obs_masked = n_phylo_obs_masked,
    # metrics (full + masked)
    !!!blk_pM, !!!blk_Mo, !!!blk_po,
    !!!blk_pM_m, !!!blk_Mo_m, !!!blk_po_m
  )
}
```

```{r}
read_results <- function(mask_frac) {
  tag  <- paste0("mask", round(mask_frac * 100))   
  comb <- file.path(fits_dir, paste0("phylopars_fits_all_", tag, ".rds"))
  readRDS(comb) 
}

all_results_list <- lapply(mask_fracs, read_results)
names(all_results_list) <- paste0("mask", round(mask_fracs * 100))
```

```{r}
summaries_by_mask <- purrr::imap(mask_fracs, function(mf, i) {
  fits <- all_results_list[[i]]
  purrr::map_dfr(names(fits), function(g) {
    res <- fits[[g]]
    one_fit_metrics(
      chem_group     = g,
      mask_frac      = mf,
      fit            = res$fit,
      wide_full      = res$wide_full,
      masked_pairs   = res$masked_pairs,
      observed_sensi = observed_sensi
    )
  })
})

fitting_summaries_phylo_ML_obs <- dplyr::bind_rows(summaries_by_mask) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(chem_group = factor(chem_group, levels = chem_groups)) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(mask_frac, chem_group)

saveRDS(fitting_summaries_phylo_ML_obs, file= here(fits_dir, "fitting_summaries_phylo_ML_obs.rds"))

```

Quick look at the pearson r comparing the masked species:
```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
plot_df <- fitting_summaries_phylo_ML_obs %>%
  mutate(
    chem_group   = factor(chem_group, levels = chem_groups),
    mask_frac_lab = paste0(round(mask_frac * 100), "%"),
    # keep your pair labels
    ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = matches("^(phylo_ML|ML_obs|phylo_obs)(masked)?_r$"),
    names_to = c("pair", "masked"),
    names_pattern = "^(phylo_ML|ML_obs|phylo_obs)(masked)?_r$",
    values_to = "r"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    mask = ifelse(is.na(masked), "Full", "Masked"),
    pair = dplyr::recode(pair,
      "phylo_ML"  = "Phylo-predicted vs ML-predicted",
      "ML_obs"    = "ML-predicted vs Observed",
      "phylo_obs" = "Phylo-predicted vs Observed"
    )
  )

pd <- position_dodge(width = 0.5)

ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = chem_group, y = r,
                    color = mask_frac_lab)) +
  geom_point(position = pd, size = 2) +
  geom_line(aes(group = interaction(chem_group, mask_frac_lab, mask)),
            position = pd, alpha = 0.5) +
  facet_grid(cols = vars(pair)) +
  labs(
    x = "Chemical group",
    y = "Pearson r",
    color = "Mask fraction"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 50, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )


```
